t: Deta TTE External Trunking Angles provide essential cable management for outdoor electrical installations. These 16mm x 16mm trunking angles are manufactured from high impact, robust heavy gauge uPVC, ensuring durable protection for cables in exposed environments. Ideal for securing and routing wiring for outdoor lighting, CCTV systems, or garden power, their resilient construction offers excellent weather resistance and long-lasting performance. The white finish integrates discreetly with many exterior surfaces, making them a practical choice for professional electricians and installers seeking reliable external cable containment solutions.
